Hi Naomi,

We're ready to add Redwood Inference to our vendor master for the Helios EU procurement instance. Purchasing has issued PO #789412 (attached) and needs a short AP onboarding packet from your side so we can complete supplier activation this week. A few specifics our AP team requires: 

- Legal name and registered VAT number as it appears on invoices
- Preferred remit-to bank details (IBAN + SWIFT) and whether Redwood supports split-remit or single remit only
- Whether you will accept Helios self-bill invoices or require standard vendor-submitted invoices
- Any withholding/tax certificates relevant to France/Germany (if applicable)

Can you send the packet and confirm whether you can accept a self-bill flow? We have a tight cutover window on Friday for first payment run.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the PO and the checklist. Attached is our AP onboarding packet tailored for Helios (Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf). Quick answers below, and I copied Laura and Marcus on the details that might need internal signoff: 

- Legal name / VAT: Redwood Inference, Inc. | EU VAT: GB999888777 (we will provide certificate copy)
- Bank remit: IBAN GB12REDW00000012345678 | SWIFT REDWGB21. We support single remit and a split-remit arrangement for multijurisdiction invoices (requires bank mandate doc)
- Invoicing: We can accept a self-bill agreement for recurring subscription charges, but we require a signed self-bill addendum and a pre-agreed invoice template. For one-off professional services we prefer vendor-submitted invoices.
- Tax evidence: we will supply VAT registration certificate and VAT exemption documentation if applicable. Withholding handling depends on the country — our compliance team will confirm specifics for France/Germany.

Items attached/links:
- Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (contains invoice examples, remit instructions, tax contacts)
- Helios_Vendor_Enrollment_Form.xlsx (completed where possible; please fill the missing fields and return)

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm whether finance will enable self-bill for subscriptions and the cutover date (you mentioned Friday)
2) If self-bill approved, sign the addendum (we can DocuSign) and we will share the sample self-bill invoice PDF for your review
3) Helios returns the completed enrollment form and PO reference in the vendor system

Laura/Marcus — can you confirm the split-remit bank mandate process and whether we have standing permissions to accept self-bill for EU customers?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Naomi — thanks for the fast response. A few clarifications from our AP team: 

- Helios can enable self-bill for subscription lines if the vendor provides the signed addendum. We will need your sample invoice format and the invoice prefix to map the file ingestion.
- For split-remit, Helios requires a bank mandate and a vendor acknowledgement; we can route the amounts to two accounts but need the bank details for both recipients.
- Please confirm whether Redwood will accept payment on NET-30 terms or prefers NET-45 for first run. Helios is willing to try NET-30 if banking cutoffs are met.

Also, we attached a completed vendor enrollment form with a few missing legal fields — can you complete and return by EOD Thursday to meet Friday cutover?

Thank you,
Helios AP Team
